title: ECP Case Candidate (review-layer intake)
description: Canonical intake representation of an UNREGISTERED, UNEXECUTED candidate case (M3-CA0, 0.3.0; extended additively in 0.4.0 with optional case_version and amendment linkage for M3-CA0-A case versioning; extended additively in 0.5.0 with optional authoring-layer fields for M3-CA0 v1: expected_property, forbidden_shortcuts, ground_truth, formal inside content, and authoring_independence, representation_bias_disclosure, environmental_pre_check at the top level — schema-optional, engine-mandatory for 0.5.0-protocol candidates). Candidates are pre-registration review material: they carry no ECP-CASE id, no ECP-REG id, and are never published to the public ledger or the public repository. Real review material (content_class 'review') lives only in a private/local review area; public illustrations under examples/ must use content_class 'format-illustration'. content_hash is SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of the content object (R1 identity). Multiple intended_correct_answers/derivations blocks are represented faithfully (all blocks retained) — the review engine flags such anomalies; the parser never silently drops or reconciles them. The formal layer (0.5.0) is PROTECTED verification material: a machine-checkable encoding whose ground truth the qualification engine verifies deterministically; it is never shown to an evaluated system.

content_class.description: 'review' = real candidate material (private review area only). 'format-illustration' = public dummy values (examples/ only). The review engine refuses 'format-illustration' inputs.

candidate_id.description: Review-layer candidate identity (NOT an ECP-CASE id, NOT an ECP-REG id; neither is ever assigned at the review layer).

case_version.description: Version of the case within the candidate lifecycle (0.4.0, optional; default 1 = the original extracted version). An amended candidate carries case_version 2+ and an amendment linkage; the prior version is immutable and remains in its own intake record.

amendment.description: Amendment linkage (0.4.0, optional; present iff this record is a review-time derived v2+ view of an amended candidate).

case_id.description: Identifier of the case inside its source document (e.g. 'C-007').

source_position.description: 1-based position of the case block within the source document (extraction order).

label.description: Human-readable label of the originating document (path-like reference, not a trust claim).

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of the source document — the provenance anchor the engine re-verifies.

raw_block.description: Verbatim source text of this candidate's block, retained for byte-level provenance-integrity verification (candidate → source → canonical artifact).

authoring_independence.description: Order §3 authoring-independence record (0.5.0, engine-mandatory for 0.5.0 candidates, schema-optional for backward compatibility). Transcribed verbatim from the provenance sidecar by the intake layer; never invented, upgraded or reinterpreted. A bare 'INDEPENDENT' status label is rejected by the qualification engine (independence is declared per dimension).

representation_bias_disclosure.description: Order §9 representation-bias disclosure (0.5.0, engine-mandatory for 0.5.0 candidates): recorded separately from structural novelty, never merged; uncertainty preserved, neutrality never manufactured.

environmental_pre_check.description: Order §10 environmental pre-check (0.5.0, engine-mandatory for 0.5.0 candidates): suspected knowledge sources, fixtures, implementation artifacts, memory paths, model-access paths, answer-bearing artifacts. NOT the formal Environmental Anti-Leakage Gate (a separate downstream gate).

registration_authoring.description: Optional registration-contract fields AUTHORED at intake time. The review engine checks their presence (R3); it never infers or authors them. Absent fields are recorded as outstanding authoring requirements, not filled in.

premises.description: Authored premise statements (numbering stripped; text verbatim).

intended_correct_answers.description: ALL authored answer blocks, faithfully retained (multiple blocks = authored anomaly, flagged by the engine, never reconciled silently).

value.description: PROTECTED-CLASS MATERIAL when content_class is 'review' (the intended answer).

source_block.description: 1-based index of the answer block within the source case block.

derivations.description: ALL authored derivation blocks, verbatim (multiple blocks = authored anomaly).

raw.description: PROTECTED-CLASS MATERIAL when content_class is 'review' (the authored derivation).

expected_property.description: 0.5.0 (order §5): the property a correct answer to this case must have — what counts as a valid response, independent of the answer's content.

forbidden_shortcuts.description: 0.5.0 (order §5): reasoning shortcuts the case forbids (mention-order heuristics, world-knowledge substitution, converse/inverse misapplication, distractor use, etc.).

ground_truth.description: 0.5.0 (order §6): the authored ground-truth claim, verified mechanically by the qualification engine against the formal layer. PROTECTED-CLASS MATERIAL when content_class is 'review'.

class.description: Order §6.4 taxonomy: derivable / contradicted / impossible / indeterminate.

statement.description: The queried proposition or finding the ground truth asserts.

ambiguity_note.description: For designed-indeterminate cases: the ambiguity reported per order §6 (never forced into a determinate class).

formal.description: 0.5.0 (order §6): machine-checkable verification layer (PROTECTED qualification material — never shown to an evaluated system). The qualification engine verifies the authored ground truth deterministically under one of four finite semantics; the layer carries no answer in NL-visible form.

domains.description: constraint-enumeration: per-variable domain specs ({'range': [lo, hi]} inclusive, or {'values': [...]}) matching 'variables' exactly.

premises.description: Semantics-specific premise encodings: rel_fact / rel_rule (relational-closure); prop_fact / impl (propositional; impl also in the strict part of default-extensions); all_different / equals / not_equal / linear / immediately_before (constraint-enumeration); default (default-extensions). Shapes are validated by the qualification engine, loudly.

query.description: The verification query: {relation, args} (relational statement), {prop, value} (propositional/default statement), {kind: consistency | repair_count}, {kind: value_of | truth_of | solution_exists, var/value} (constraint).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of the content object. Deterministic identity of the reviewed material; the engine recomputes and compares (R1).

self_review_value.description: Author self-report values, transcribed verbatim (a self-report, not a verified property).

transformation_history.description: Ordered events from authoring to delivery (generation, repairs, mechanical splice), each with evidence reference. Timestamps must be non-decreasing (engine-verified).

status.description: 'COMPLETE' = all provenance fields available; 'PARTIAL' = some fields honestly recorded NOT AVAILABLE; 'MISSING' = provenance substance absent (declared); 'BROKEN' = provenance declared or detected as internally inconsistent.

not_available.description: Provenance fields honestly recorded as NOT AVAILABLE (never invented).

source_report_flags.description: Honest limitations recorded by the delivery/source report (e.g. 'model-family-overlap', 'sampling-non-reproducible'). Recorded, never adjudicated, by the review layer.

candidate_flags.description: Candidate-specific flags recorded by the source report (e.g. 'nondeterminate-answer-design').
